notes.subject: במעדר
notes.rationale: spet (mattock/hoe) — dispela tok i save kamap nem long hia na long Aisaia 7:24 tasol.

notes.subject: יראת שמיר ושית
notes.rationale: KJV/JPS ritim olsem 'lip long ol nil na ol gerrat gras' (man i no ken kam longen), tasol BSB ritim olsem 'bilong ol nil' olsem ol samting yet.

notes.subject: ולמרמס
notes.rationale: ASV/JPS 'treading' — mi givim 'putim leg', wanpela pasin bilong bulmakau na sipsip long wokabaut olgeta long graun.

notes.subject: ולמרמס
notes.rationale: Strong i tok 'abasement', tasol long konteks em i tok bilong ol sipsip long waswas long graun; mi wasim tok 'putim leg'.

translation: Na olgeta ol maunten we ol i wasim long spet, long-en i no ken kam, long lip long ol nil na ol nil gras; na bai em i kamap ples bilong salim olgeta ⟨ol⟩ bulmakau man, na bilong ol sipsip long putim leg.
